stories.name: AMD valuation debate
stories.blurb: AMD keeps beating earnings estimates, but investors are increasingly questioning whether its stock price has risen too high to justify further gains.

stories.name: Nvidia CEO crisis
stories.blurb: Nvidia is in turmoil over the fate of CEO Jensen Huang, with reports and speculation that the board may oust him, sending the stock swinging as investors await the outcome.

stories.name: AMD AI chip race
stories.blurb: A series of headlines analyzing whether AMD can challenge Nvidia and other rivals in the booming market for AI chips, and whether its stock is a buy or sell.

stories.name: AMD Rally in AI Boom
stories.blurb: AMD stock repeatedly surges and flashes buy signals amid a broader AI-driven rally lifting tech shares and major indexes like the Nasdaq, S&P 500, and Dow.

rel.why: Headlines center on AMD's own stock buy signals and its role in the AI-driven rally, bearing directly on AMD.

stories.name: AMD 2026 election rally
stories.blurb: AMD shares surged after Democrats swept the 2026 midterms and the company posted strong Q3 earnings, though the stock later gave back gains as it led S&P 500 losers in subsequent sessions.

stories.name: AMD as Nvidia alternative
stories.blurb: Investors and analysts are increasingly favoring AMD as a rival AI chip play amid Nvidia's leadership uncertainty and stock volatility.

past.name: AMD AI Expansion
past.blurb: AMD is expanding its AI compute strategy through acquisitions like World Labs and Taalas, new Helion rack-scale agentic AI infrastructure, and a deepened Meta partnership.

past.name: Marvell stock outlook
past.blurb: Investors and analysts debate whether Marvell Technology's AI-driven growth and widening margins make its stock a buy after a sharp pullback.

past.name: Meta AI funding deal
past.blurb: Meta is raising tens of billions in equity and preferred stock to fund its massive AI infrastructure build-out, with Nvidia and AMD investing billions as they compete in custom chips.

past.name: AMD trading activity
past.blurb: A series of headlines tracking how major funds like ARK Invest and the iShares SOXX semiconductor ETF have been buying and selling AMD shares amid broader portfolio shifts.

past.name: AMD trillion-dollar milestone
past.blurb: AMD's stock surge has pushed the chipmaker past a $1 trillion market capitalization for the first time, driven by analyst upgrades and booming demand for its server CPUs.

past.name: AMD AI stock rally
past.blurb: A cluster of news items about AMD and related tech companies riding an AI-driven surge in stock prices and analyst attention.

past.name: HPE AI Momentum
past.blurb: Hewlett Packard Enterprise shares are surging to record highs on upgraded networking guidance and a $1.2 billion AMD AI server deal, drawing analyst price-target hikes and investor-day buzz.

past.name: Cathie Wood AI pivot
past.blurb: Cathie Wood's ARK funds are rotating out of bitcoin and chip stocks like AMD and into AI infrastructure and neocloud plays, a shift other investors and analysts are also making.

10.text: Intel shares jumped 7.52% on Nov. 11 amid a broader chip rally, then chip stocks sold off Nov. 16–17 on AI-spending fears, Nvidia leadership uncertainty, export restrictions, and a lawsuit against Intel. Intel has fallen about 60% since June after a profit-reset forecast; AMD had little company-specific news but slid with the sector.

9.text: AMD shares have surged 123% year-to-date, with Q3 revenue of $13.4 billion (up 45% YoY) and data center revenue up 97%, while the stock trades at a premium 38.39X forward P/E. Bank of America raised its price target, citing the Zen 6 roadmap and CPU share gains, and AMD completed an $8.2 billion acquisition of World Labs.

12.text: Jensen Huang resigned as Nvidia CEO amid a personal-conduct scandal and an investigation into chips reaching China via a Singapore customer, wiping $430 billion off Nvidia's value. Nvidia was downgraded to Hold by Truist and Craig-Hallum, CFO Colette Kress became interim CEO, and Q3 earnings loom.

13.text: AMD’s data center revenue nearly doubled and it posted a record quarter, with analysts citing Meta and OpenAI partnerships and 45% revenue growth versus Intel’s 21%. Most articles compare AMD favorably to Intel and Marvell but flag Nvidia’s dominance, a rich valuation, and Broadcom’s $27B cash-flow edge.

11.text: AMD rose as a key AI-driven market mover on Nov 11, then fell in Nov 13 premarket trading. Other articles cover Nvidia earnings, AI stocks, and broader market moves with only passing AMD mentions.

20.text: AMD surged on an analyst upgrade Nov 12 amid Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang's resignation, then fell 9.42% on Nov 13 as a S&P 500 top loser and gap-down stock. It was also among the most active S&P 500 names Nov 11.

21.text: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang resigned amid scandal and board turmoil, prompting William Blair to upgrade AMD to Outperform and investors to rotate into AMD and Broadcom. AMD shares jumped about 30% in a week, with analysts projecting over 80% growth and $77B in data-center sales by 2027.

7.text: BofA projects the server CPU market could exceed $240 billion by 2030, with AMD well positioned for agentic AI growth. William Blair upgraded AMD to Outperform, and Anthropic disclosed a $2.5 billion AMD purchase at IPO price.

8.text: Neither article mentions AMD; both cover Intel stock after its earnings call. The story bears on AMD only as Intel's rival in the same chip market.

19.text: iShares PHLX SOX Semiconductor sold $17.0 million of AMD on Tuesday while adding ASML and Analog Devices. AMD was only mentioned as a fund holding being trimmed.
